name: geornd_size
expr: s1 = size(geornd(p, 3)); s2 = size(geornd(p, 2, 3)); s3 = size(geornd(p, [2 3])); s4 = size(geornd(p, -1)); s5 = size(geornd(p, [], 3)); s6 = size(geornd(p, 2, [])); n1 = size(normrnd(0, 1, [2 3])); n2 = size(poissrnd(2, 3));
comment: *rnd size-input contract (argcheck migration 2026-09-17): scalar n -> nxn; (m,n) -> mxn; [m n] vector -> mxn; NEGATIVE size and EMPTY size argument both mean a zero dimension (R2025b-probed: geornd(p,-1) -> 0x0, geornd(p,[],3) -> 0x3, geornd(p,2,[]) -> 2x0). Values are random - the fingerprint pins output SHAPES only, deterministic across engines. Fractional/NaN/complex size inputs error (covered by gtest). Deferred: [m n p ...] N-D vector form returns flattened 2-D (bugs/opened/stats/rnd-size-vector-nd.md); mvnrnd explicit zero n (bugs/opened/stats/mvnrnd-zero-n.md).
